resolution.note: regression test: lane subagent Stop check with payload cwd in a foreign repo judges the claimed lane worktree

title: A lane Stop check runs in the lead session cwd instead of the lane worktree
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: the lead session cd-ed into .krn/tmp/s29/real (another repository); a background lane's Stop hook (bin/krn hook stop --check) then ran that repository's node --test tests/ instead of the lane worktree session-cap and blocked the lane.
Outcome: the Stop check of a lane resolves the lane worktree from its claim, never the session cwd; a lane stop with the session cwd in another repository exits 0 when the lane worktree is green.
Proof: a regression test runs the stop check with cwd in a foreign git repository and a lane claim, and asserts it checks the lane worktree.
